name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: A compound button group component with sizes, icons, and toggle group support via asChild. Uses namespace exports: ButtonGroup.Root, ButtonGroup.Item, ButtonGroup.Icon.

docs.lead: A compound button group component with sizes, icons, and toggle group support via asChild.
docs.usage:
import * as ButtonGroup from "@/components/ui/button-group"

<ButtonGroup.Root>
  <ButtonGroup.Item>
    <ButtonGroup.Icon as={GridIcon} />
    Grid view
  </ButtonGroup.Item>
  <ButtonGroup.Item>List view</ButtonGroup.Item>
</ButtonGroup.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A basic button group with icons and labels.
examples.code:
<ButtonGroup.Root>
  <ButtonGroup.Item>
    <ButtonGroup.Icon as={RiLayoutGridLine} />
    Grid view
  </ButtonGroup.Item>
  <ButtonGroup.Item>
    <ButtonGroup.Icon as={RiListCheck} />
    List view
  </ButtonGroup.Item>
  <ButtonGroup.Item>
    <ButtonGroup.Icon as={RiLayout2Line} />
    Gallery view
  </ButtonGroup.Item>
</ButtonGroup.Root>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Button groups come in small (default), xsmall, and xxsmall sizes.

api.name: ButtonGroup.Root
api.description: The container that groups items together with negative spacing.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the button group items

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: ButtonGroup.Item
api.description: An individual button within the group. Supports active state via data-[state=on].

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

api.name: ButtonGroup.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon container that receives size from ButtonGroup.Root.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as
